dedupe_keys.name: power dataset code photovoltaic and wind power simulator

description: Power-dataset-code simulates photovoltaic-panel and wind-turbine output from measured and forecast weather inputs. The repository maintained by danilopsv provides MATLAB code and a worked procedure for Natal and Santa Vitoria do Palmar, Brazil. Its README names two raw-data MAT files and describes four output columns: measured and forecast wind power, and measured and forecast photovoltaic power, all in watts. Users choose an hourly simulation interval and can save the output as MAT or tab-delimited data. Zenodo preserves version v1.0.0 as a free ZIP download, labelled Other (Open); GitHub reports no recognised licence, so the precise reuse terms remain unclear. The code requires MATLAB 2016a or later and Hysdel 2.0.6. Those dependencies were not installed and the simulator was not run. The example observation dates are not stated in the README. It can support forecast-sensitive microgrid dispatch studies and could supply generation series for model-pypsa, but that connection has not been tested.
name: Power-dataset-code: photovoltaic and wind power simulator
notes: G2 G2-0005. Zenodo identifies software, separate from the associated Mendeley measurement dataset (G2-0014). Other (Open) is the repository licence category, not a verified SPDX licence. MATLAB cost and dependency licences are separate. Simulation reuse and PyPSA connection are reviewer assessments.
